messages.quest.courier_roads.night_run.descriptio: Prove the courier road can survive the dangers that wait between houses and villages.
messages.quest.courier_roads.night_run.scene.nigh: The dangerous stretch is clear. Bring lanterns and signs so the next courier needs less courage.
I marked the blocked stretch beyond the lamps: webs in the hedges and skeletons watching the road.
quest.courier_roads.night_run.stage.clea: A route is not real until someone can take it when the sun is gone.
Clear the worst of the night road, then bring lanterns and signs. A brave courier is useful; a visible road is kinder.
messages.quest.courier_roads.night_run.stage.clea: I will test the night road.
quest.courier_roads.night_run.stage.clea: Clear spiders and skeletons from the route. Messages should not need armor to arrive.
messages.quest.courier_roads.night_run.stage.clea: Defeat 2 skeletons before couriers have to cross their aim.
Defeat 3 spiders along the night route.
quest.courier_roads.night_run.stage.clea: Then the sealed packets stay in daylight a while longer.
Do not race the dark just to impress it.
Defeat 3 spiders and 2 skeletons along the night route.
The night road is not ready for that work right now.
The night run has already been proven.
Defeat 3 spiders and 2 skeletons. Bring back a road that feels less hungry.
The night route is not ready to ask for help right now.
quest.courier_roads.night_run.stage.mark: The dangerous stretch is quieter. Now mark it so the next person does not need your luck.
messages.quest.courier_roads.night_run.stage.mark: Bring 3 lanterns to mark the night road.
Bring 3 oak signs so tired couriers do not guess at turns.
quest.courier_roads.night_run.stage.mark: A marked road is a promise to strangers.
Bring 3 lanterns and 3 oak signs for the night road.
The road markers can wait until the dangerous stretch is clear.
quest.courier_roads.night_run.stage.retu: You brought back proof and markers. That is the difference between a stunt and a road.
Good. The first night courier will still be nervous, but now nervous has lanterns to follow.
The night road still needs its patrol cleared and its lanterns and signs placed.
Bring the road markers here so the route can be written down.
I cannot close the night route right now.
A road half-marked can be worse than no road at all.
messages.quest.courier_roads.night_run.stage.retu: Return with proof and road markers.
messages.quest.courier_roads.night_run.title: The Night Run
